title: hydrocotyle hirta var. pusilla
intro: Hydrocotyle hirta var. pusilla, commonly known as Java water pennywort, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Hydrocotylaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to help with anxiety, stress, and insomnia, due to its calming effects and ability to promote relaxation. The health benefits of Java water pennywort are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including its anxiolytic, sedative, and antispasmodic properties, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Java water pennywort include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
